scenario: Compare the three provider bills, original and corrected EOBs, my payment receipt, and the refund notice I supplied for this service period. Show which lines are demonstrably linked, what changed in reprocessing, which payments have no provider posting evidence, and which items need a billing-office or insurer answer. Do not interpret coverage, decide what I owe, infer coding errors, contact anyone, disclose records, file an appeal, or pay anything.

messages.text: Compare the three provider bills, original and corrected EOBs, my payment receipt, and the refund notice I supplied for this service period. Show which lines are demonstrably linked, what changed in reprocessing, which payments have no provider posting evidence, and which items need a billing-office or insurer answer. Do not interpret coverage, decide what I owe, infer coding errors, contact anyone, disclose records, file an appeal, or pay anything.
I inventoried 14 synthetic documents and 7 service lines across three providers. The corrected EOB replaces the original for comparisons; the reversed EOB remains visible without current arithmetic.
Make the result useful in an ordinary chat client and leave a durable handoff.

The handoff contains a USD 10.00 difference between two reported charge fields, an unposted USD 25.00 receipt, a USD 5.00 refund notice without a receipt, and nine patient-owned questions. These observations do not establish an amount owed.
